parts.note_add: The 1982 brochure (S-004 p.15) lists reclining bucket seats with all-vinyl or vinyl-and-velour upholstery for the S and GS; only the GSL had tweed seats with adjustable headrests, which suggests the S/GS seat is the high-back type without a separate head restraint - check the seat type. The 1985 manual (S-002 sec.14 p.14-3) shows the seat as adjusters, reclining knuckle, knuckle cover, cushion, back, hinge cover, washer, bush and bolt; inspection is that the adjuster lever and knuckle move smoothly (grease them) and the mounting bolts are tight.

Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.58) confirms FA07-88-160 cloth-velour and FA08-88-160 vinyl for S and GS, black 00, red 10, brown 70 (vinyl: black 00, brown 70 only). No new Mazda cushion found; Racing Beat's 81-83 lo-back cover kit (vinyl, black, burgundy or briar brown, built to order) is the reproduction route for the cover.

Reproduction: Racing Beat 81-83 lo-back seat covers, fabric-backed heavyweight vinyl, sold as a pair with hog rings and pliers, for seats originally in non-leather covers, built to order (8-10 weeks, not returnable), GBP 431.52 ex VAT at Racing Beat Europe 2026-09-27 (racingbeat.com refused the fetch). Check the seat type before ordering: the kit is for the lo-back seat.

No new frame-and-pad found. Owners report (rx7club) the pad is two densities and the dense bolster inserts crumble with age, tearing the cover at the bolster seam; repair is new foam cut to the frame under a new cover.
Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.57) confirms FA07-88-130/FA08-88-130 pattern for the right and the same colours (black 00, red 10, brown 70; vinyl black 00, brown 70). No new Mazda seat back found.

Catalogue p.57 lists the right back trim as FA07-88-131 (cloth-velour) / FA08-88-131 (vinyl), so the left should follow the -181 pattern of the cushion (-161); the print stays unresolved. Reproduction cover: the Racing Beat 81-83 lo-back kit (pair, cushion and back).

Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.58) prints the right back frame as FA02-88-140 (non-high-back) or 8871-88-140 (high-back), matching the left numbers here. No new frame-and-pad found; see the rx7club foam thread.

Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.58) confirms FA09-88-151 (with knuckle cover) or 8532-88-151 (without) for the left, qty 1; knuckle screws 2155-57-109 x8 and, with a cover, 1243-88-117 x2. 1985 manual inspection (S-002 sec.14 p.14-3): the knuckle must move smoothly, grease the moving parts. Not found for sale new.
Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.57-58) gives the right cover as F007-88-120 ('81) or 8183-88-120 ('82), non-high-back type only; the '82 left is 8183-88-170. Not found for sale.
Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.56) prints 0305-57-081 black 00, qty 2, used without a knuckle cover. Not found for sale under this number.
Fitted with bushing 8531-88-106 x2 and washer 8531-88-105 x2 (S-005 Body-Index p.56). Not found for sale.
Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.58) confirms F005-88-152, left seat. Not found for sale new; the only related CAD is the 79-80 rail knob 8038-88-109 (printable, close fit only).
Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.58) confirms FA07-88-153, left seat. Not found for sale new.

Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.66): '81 belts were 8872-57-610A/B, the '82 FA30-57-610 covers FB331 600001-622565 in black 00, wine/red 12, brown 24, tan/black 29. No genuine belt found; Seatbelt Planet sells a new retractable 3-point belt with end-release buckle for 1978-85 RX-7, either side, USD 170.95, no mounting hardware. 1985 manual (S-002 sec.14 p.14-4): do not disassemble the retractor; fit the retractor bolt so the retractor sits vertical; removal is rear floor mat, floor plate, anchor bolt, retractor bolt.

Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.66): FA30-57-620 for '82 and '83; black 00, red 12, brown/black 24, tan/black 29 to serial FB331 700000, dark tan 75 from 700001. Not found new; the Seatbelt Planet kit replaces the whole belt.
Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.66) confirms FA30-57-630 for '82 and '83, qty 2 (black 00, red/black 12, brown 24, tan/black 29). Not found new.

Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.66-67): the '82 FA30-57-670 covers FB331 600001-622565 in black 00, wine/red 12, brown 24, tan/black 29 ('81 was 8872-57-670A/B). Same replacement kit as the right (Seatbelt Planet, USD 170.95). 1985 manual (S-002 sec.14 p.14-4): anchor bolts 39-55 N-m; retractor sits vertical; do not disassemble the retractor.

The driver's buckle carries the seat belt warning switch (S-001 sec.H device H-04, wires Br and BrW to the control processing unit); the 1985 manual (S-002 sec.15 p.15-25) tests it as continuity with the belt out, none with the belt in. Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.67): FA30-57-680 for '82 and '83; black 00, red 12, brown/black 24, tan/black 29 to serial FB331 700000, dark tan 75 from 700001.

Catalogue figure 5840A-1 (S-005 Body-Index p.72) read from the page: FA01-68-420A is S/GS red 10 only; FA01-68-420D vinyl and FA02-68-420D cloth, S and GS, black 00, red 10, brown 70; the brochure (S-004 p.15) gives matching fabric door trim to the GSL only. No factory-style reproduction found; LRB Speed makes brushed 1.5 mm aluminium door panels for the 79-85 FB (pair from USD 166, with pull straps and hardware, factory mounting points). Atkins reproduces the trim clip 0208-58-921 (USD 3.50) and grommet 0187-58-922 (USD 4.00). Removal (S-002 sec.14 p.14-9): regulator handle, inner handle cover, arm rest, then the trim panel.

Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.72-73) confirms FA01-68-450D vinyl and FA02-68-450D cloth for S and GS, black 00, red 10, brown 70. Same reproduction (LRB Speed aluminium pair) and clips (Atkins 0208-58-921, 0187-58-922) as the right.

Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.73): black 00, red 10, tan 29 (from serial FB331 600001), brown 80; fixed by two 998306625 screws. Discontinued by Mazda: Atkins lists FA01-69-371A-00 black at USD 29.25 as no longer available and Mazdatrix lists it discontinued (2026-09-27); used only.
Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.73): black 00, red 10, tan 29 (from serial FB331 600001), brown 80. The right handle is discontinued at Atkins and Mazdatrix; no listing for the left found; used only.

The catalogue print (S-005 Body-Index p.72, item 58 811A) reads 8871-53-781 or 8871-58-781; Atkins and eBay OEM listings use 8871-58-781, which matches the D-code - check. Mazda has discontinued it; Atkins Rotary makes a reproduction (USD 25 each, fits either side, two per car, 2026-09-27).
Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.72, item 58 821A) confirms 8871-58-791, qty 2. Mazda has discontinued it; Atkins Rotary makes a reproduction (USD 25 each, fits either side, two per car, 2026-09-27).
